note: NOTE: subtype_id values are used by items.subtype_id (materials only). general belongs to Neutral (e.g. Training Scroll). earth is elemental/magical earth energy, distinct from Nature stone.

rows.name: Wood
rows.description: Timber, bark, twigs, logs, and other plant matter from trees and plants.

rows.name: Stone
rows.description: Rock, mineral chunks, clay, and earth taken from the ground.

rows.name: Iron
rows.description: Raw metal and ferrous scrap used in tools, armor, and heavier crafts.

rows.name: Hide
rows.description: Leather, pelts, wool, fur, feathers, and other hides from natural creatures.

rows.name: Fire
rows.description: Heat, embers, and flame essences drawn from fire elemental sources.

rows.name: Ice
rows.description: Frost, snow, and frozen essences drawn from ice elemental sources.

rows.name: Lightning
rows.description: Sparks, charged shards, and storm essences drawn from lightning elemental sources.

rows.name: Earth
rows.description: Elemental, magical earth energy — distinct from Nature's physical stone. Found as shards and crystals.

rows.name: Holy
rows.description: Blessed light and sacred relics of faith and protection.

rows.name: Arcane
rows.description: Pure magical residue and runic fragments of learned spellcraft.

rows.name: Curse
rows.description: Tainted, hexed matter bound to misfortune and dark magic.

rows.name: Soul
rows.description: Echoes of spirit and life essence drawn from living or departed beings.

rows.name: General
rows.description: Plain general materials any monster can drop (e.g. Training Scroll). Currencies are not subtypes.
